verdict.rationale: Trello's own Power-Up framework lets developers add UI that sits inside the product: board buttons, card badges on the card front, dynamic buttons on the card back, and attachment sections that pull in third-party data. These are native extension surfaces, but the evidence only covers card- and board-level embellishments, not full custom views or dashboard widgets. missing for 10: documented custom board/view rendering surfaces, dashboard-style widget capability, design-system/native styling guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product

citations.quote: Provide extra perspective on the front of a card with data in card badges!
Add dynamic buttons on the back of a card so users can interact with your product!
Pull in data from third party services like image previews or status updates and share it with users in attachment sections!
Add buttons to a Trello board to trigger magic and delight!
